info.text:
Debit card skimmed? You can owe $0, if you act fast.

Skimming costs banks and consumers over $1 billion a year (FBI).
Over 243,000 US debit cards were compromised in 2025, up 5% (FICO). The Secret Service pulled 411 skimmers in 2025.
Regulation E: if your card was skimmed but you still have it, report within 60 days of your statement and you owe $0. If the card is stolen, report within 2 business days to cap it at $50.

Sources: FBI, FICO, US Secret Service (Jan 2026), CFPB (12 CFR 1005.6).
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
